items.title: John Handy Interview, 1958-12-04
items.q: Well then Toody Harris' band they had Lyle Thompson on drums. Lurt Fritz on trombone. We had Ed Collins on trumpet. Guy Kelly on trumpet. Joe Robich on piano. Poise Sevilla on guitar. And I was playing clarinet. Clarence Hall was playing tenor saxophone.

ctx.x: No, I don't think you know him. Toody Harris, he was a big fella too. He was around 200 pounds. Well then Toody Harris' band they had Lyle Thompson on drums. Lurt Fritz on trombone. We had Ed Collins on trumpet. Guy Kelly on trumpet. Joe Robich on piano. Poise Sevilla on guitar. And I was playing clarinet. Clarence Hall was playing tenor saxophone. And a fella by the name of, what was his name? Oh I forget his name. But then he was on alto.
Where was that? No, it was in Baton Rouge. Oh. No, it was in Baton Rouge.

items.title: John Handy Interview, 1963-11-21
items.q: One time I had John Marrera, Albert, uh... Morgan, Joe Rubishow, uh... Crown's Hall, his brother. Not Edwin, I believe the one called Charlie. He was a tenor player too.

ctx.x: I don't know his last name. His name was Tink. Well, anyway, I was playing there with him. And, uh, him and the boss got himself gonna misunderstanding or something. And, uh... He asked me could I bring him a piano player? I said, well, we got a piano player. He said, no, Tink quit tonight. I said, yeah, I'll get your piano player if he quit. He said, yeah, he quit. He said, yeah, he quit. He told me tonight he quit. I got Joe Rubishow. And put him in there. That's how I got to do it. That's at La Vida. At La…
What kind of music did you have to play out there?
